# ce_source: sel_inband = in-band IPMI SEL logs every CE (visible -> ceiling L2/L3); none = platform does not record CE;

#            "受限" (MEM-O2, plan v1.2 R-6: limited by default, full only after proven visible).
# redfish: what the daily Redfish poll on 10.80.32.234 provides (none / ue_replaced / disabled / dimm_health / metrics_weekly).
